name: robotizer
description:
Robot and whisper voices: keep the magnitudes of speech, replace its phase.

  robot    all bins peak together, once per frame, so the voice takes on
           one fixed pitch: the frame rate, sr * 4 / bs (375 Hz at 48 kHz
           with blocks of 512).  A phase of pi * bin puts that peak in the
           middle of the frame, where the window is widest; a phase of 0
           would put it at the edges, where the window is closed.
  whisper  a new random phase per bin per frame, so no pitch survives

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
